# Greater Water

> Greater Water is a local water delivery business based in Spring Hill, near Orange, NSW. We deliver bulk water, tank refills and potable drinking water to homes, farms, rural properties and businesses across Orange, Bathurst and the Central West of NSW.

Phone: 0488 654 416 (24 hours a day, 7 days a week)
Website: https://greaterwater.com.au/
Address: 186 Davis Rd, Spring Hill NSW 2800

## Services
- Bulk water delivery
- Tank water refills
- Potable drinking water delivery
- Residential, rural and farm, and commercial water delivery

## Service areas
Orange, Bathurst, Blayney, Molong, Canowindra, Cowra, Oberon and the wider Central West NSW. Call to confirm delivery to your location.

## Good to know
- Same day delivery is the aim where possible, and delivery can generally be arranged within 24 hours at busier times.
- Delivery starts from approximately $350. Final pricing depends on location, quantity and site access.
- Trucks are equipped with features including differential locks to help reach more difficult rural sites.
